title: Copy into a Fixed Buffer
hints: Handle `cap == 0` first: there is no room for anything, so return 0 without touching `dst`. After that you know at least one byte is yours, and it is reserved for the terminator.

Copy while two things are both true: there is still room for this char *and* a terminator after it (`i + 1 < cap`), and `src[i]` is not `'\0'`. Do not write `i < cap - 1` out of habit before the `cap == 0` check: `cap - 1` wraps for an unsigned zero. After the loop, write `dst[i] = '\0';` and return `i`.
